headline: Updates on the 210 Bog Road demolition, Demolition Delay Ordinance amendments, and the Master Plan 2030.
summary: The agenda lists updates on the 210 Bog Road demolition, the Demolition Delay Ordinance amendments, and the Master Plan, including a review of Section VIII Historic Resources. Note: the posted agenda is dated October 1, 2026, not November 5, 2026.
items: Review Section VIII Historic Resources of the Master Plan 2030

Nominations of Heritage Commission members to the Planning Board's Master Plan Advisory Subcommittee
City Council Update: Demolition Delay Ordinance Amendments
location: City Council Chambers, 37 Green Street, Concord, NH 03301
